prompt: Multiply $(x + 5)(x + 2)$. What is the coefficient of the $x$ term in the result?
hint: Use the area model: 4 patches. Two of them are $x$-patches.

hints.text: Use the area model: 4 patches. Two of them are $x$-patches.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try $(x + 1)(x + 2)$: the middle terms are $2x + 1x = 3x$. The x-coefficient is just the two numbers ADDED.
The $x$-patches are $2 \times x$ and $5 \times x$. Add them.

alternativeExplanations.title: Garden patches
steps: A garden (x + 5) by (x + 2) splits into 4 patches: a square x by x, a 2-by-x strip, a 5-by-x strip, and a 5-by-2 corner.
The two strips are the x-terms: 2x and 5x, which is 7x together. Coefficient: 7.

alternativeExplanations.title: Shortcut for this pattern
steps: For (x + a)(x + b), the middle coefficient is always a + b.
Here a = 5 and b = 2, so the x coefficient is 5 + 2 = 7.
